question: Which techniques does software S0266 (TrickBot) use?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: TrickBot (S0266) utilizes many MITRE ATT&CK techniques, including Software Packing (T1027.002), Firmware Corruption (T1495), Credential API Hooking (T1056.004), and discovery methods such as System Owner/User Discovery (T1033) and Local Account discovery (T1087.001). It also employs execution and persistence methods like Spearphishing Link (T1566.002), Spearphishing Attachment (T1566.001), and Windows Service (T1543.003), as well as obfuscation techniques like Standard Encoding (T1132.001) and Symmetric Cryptography (T1573.001).
